data.name: ACT Group
data.description: ACT Group (founded 2009, headquartered in Amsterdam) is a global environmental commodities broker and decarbonization solutions provider operating across carbon credits, EACs, renewable fuels, and emissions allowances. It develops and facilitates climate projects — including biochar-based CDR transactions such as the Freres Lumber project sold to Microsoft — but acts as an intermediary, trader, and project developer rather than operating physical CDR technology itself.
